subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook mappings support automatic post-failure fallback delivery, and if yes should the public config be an ordered fallbackChannels chain, reuse cron failureDestination, or avoid cross-channel failover?
rationale: This adds public config and cross-channel delivery semantics, and repository policy treats fallback/config additions as product- and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add ordered fallbackChannels
options.body: Add a typed ordered fallback list for hook mappings and attempt alternates only after a real primary delivery failure, with explicit docs and tests for all-targets-failed behavior.

options.title: Reuse cron failureDestination
options.body: Route hook delivery through an existing failure-destination concept if maintainers want one shared failure-notification model instead of hook-specific failover.

options.title: Do not add cross-channel failover
options.body: Keep hook mappings single-target and document failureDestination, bestEffort, and channel health as the supported recovery paths.

recommendation.title: Add ordered fallbackChannels
recommendation.body: Add a typed ordered fallback list for hook mappings and attempt alternates only after a real primary delivery failure, with explicit docs and tests for all-targets-failed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has both the hook mapping introduction history and prior review context on this exact issue.
